question:
From the options given below choose the synonym (similar meaning) of the word:

Alienate
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Alienate"** means to cause someone to feel isolated or estranged. (अलग करना, पराया करना)

 
 
• **Example: **His rude comments **alienated **his friends, causing them to avoid him.
 
 
 
• **"Estrange"** refers to causing someone to be no longer on friendly terms with someone else. (अलग करना, दूर करना)
 
 
• **Example: **Constant arguments **estranged **the once close-knit family members.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Secure** (सुरक्षित): To make something safe or free from danger.

 
 
• **Example:** She managed to secure a good job after graduation.
 
 
 
• **Vacate** (खाली करना): To leave a place that one previously occupied.
 
 
• **Example: **All residents were asked to vacate the building due to safety concerns.
 
 
 
• **Sever** (काट देना): To cut off or separate.
 
 
• **Example:** The company decided to sever ties with the supplier due to quality issues.
